Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely and incorrectly asserted that the Celtic ruler (Cogidubnus) was “born around AD 43,” an unsupported and implausible claim. This introduced a faulty premise at the outset, risked misframing the historical timeline (and later confusion between Roman Republic vs Roman Empire), and led to unnecessary, repetitive verification steps rather than directly concluding the correct conquering empire (Roman).
